title: Makefile: properly rebuild go-md2man on changes
body:
The file existence check meant once it was build once it never got rebuild again meaning local devs are stucked with outdated versions even after go-md2man updates.

The test/tools Makefile already specifies the SOURCES to only rebuild on changes so we can just always call the build target.

I noticed this while reviewing
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29900
